title: 19-Year-Old Gets Caught Going 112 mph Because He Was Late For A Party
description:
On January 28, 2022, a Wisconsin State Trooper clocked a vehicle traveling at 112 mph in a posted 70 mph zone on I-94 in Eau Claire County. When the trooper asked why they were speeding, the 19-year-old driver had an interesting reason…
